Lune is a concept for a relaxed neighbourhood bistro. The menu and atmosphere take centre stage, while finding a table stays simple.

Lune is not a real restaurant. The name, menu and opening hours demonstrate Nortivo’s website work.

Can I book a real table here?

No. Lune is a fictional restaurant created to showcase Nortivo’s website work. The table selector only demonstrates how booking could work.

What do the menu filters show?

Browse small plates, mains and desserts, or show the vegetarian dishes in the example menu. Dishes, prices and allergens are fictional.

Is any booking information saved?

No. Your table selection only exists while the page is open. No reservation, payment or message is sent.
